titleInfo.subTitle: lessons in creativity from IDEO, America's leading design firm

titleInfo.title: Lessons in creativity from IDEO

abstract.#text: The general manager of IDEO, the design firm that created the Apple Mouse and the Palm V, reveals strategies for fostering imagination, expressing ideas, and developing hit products by bringing out the creativity in every employee.

tableOfContents.#text: Foreword / Tom Peters -- Innovation at the top -- Winging it in start-up mode -- Innovation begins With an eye -- The perfect brainstorm -- A cool company needs hot groups -- Prototyping is the shorthand of innovation -- Build your greenhouse -- Expect the unexpected -- Barrier jumping -- Creating experiences for fun and profit -- Zero to sixty -- Coloring outside the lines -- In search of the "wet nap" interface -- Live the future -- Getting in the swing.
